The fee calculation does feeAmount.mul(burnFee).div(totalFee), which will revert if totalFee == 0. The oracle checks if totalFee == 0, indicating we need to trigger this division by zero. We can exploit this by becoming the owner, setting all fees to 0 (making totalFee = 0), enabling trading, and then performing a transfer to trigger the division by zero in takeFee().

Perform a transfer between two non-exempt addresses to trigger takeFee() which will divide by totalFee (0), causing a revert. This demonstrates the vulnerability.

If totalFee == burnFee, then totalETHFee = 0, causing division by zero.
